issue.title: test_J_switches_to_the_pulse_and_enter_returns_to_the_inbox stays on archive under Full CI
issue.description:
FAIL: Full CI 39104985574, Python 3.12 job 117611242219, SHA ae9f044bb39c22ab5702031b1507249e29a2d4da.
https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/39104985574/job/117611242219
FAILED tests/ace/tui/test_agent_archive_column_app.py::test_J_switches_to_the_pulse_and_enter_returns_to_the_inbox
AssertionError: assert 'archive' == 'inbox' at tests/ace/tui/test_agent_archive_column_app.py:215
(active_view stayed AGENTS_VIEW_ARCHIVE after J then Enter; expected inbox).

PASS on the unchanged tree: Full CI 39120426524 Python 3.12 at the same SHA failed only test_files_ctrl_j_scrolls_page_anchor_to_top; this archive node was absent from that failed summary. Full CI 39092843619, 39097854068, and 39112297316 completed success on the same SHA.

Fail rate in the watch window: 1 of 5 completed Full CI runs on ae9f044bb3 (the 3.12 job of 39104985574). Not reproduced serially here. Adjacent sase-1ky covers a different node in the same file (Today-banner expand/repaint), not this pulse/Enter inbox return. Closed Agents Archive epics (sase-1jm family) do not own residual CI flakes.
